description: Marine, maritime, nautical and sailing data for AI assistants and chatbots. Mediterranean marine forecast: wind, wave, swell, gust. Tide tables and tidal predictions. Sea routing and passage planning on a coastline-aware maritime graph. Curated POIs: marinas, ports, harbors, anchorages, moorings, fuel. Real data, cited sources, never invented.
